Free background remover, image compressor, resizer & converter

BG Studio is a free online image tool that runs entirely in your browser. Remove the background from a photo, make an image file smaller, change its width and height, and convert between PNG, JPG, WebP and AVIF, all without uploading anything.

How do I remove the background from an image?

  1. Drop your image into the page, or click to browse (you can also paste a screenshot).
  2. Click Remove background. The tool detects the background color automatically. For better results, click Pick color and tap the background.
  3. Adjust tolerance and edge softness until the edges look clean, then download as PNG or WebP to keep the transparent background.

Frequently asked questions

How do I make an image file smaller?

Choose WebP, AVIF or JPEG and lower the quality slider, or type a target size in KB and the tool finds the best quality for you. Reducing the width and height shrinks the file even more.

Which image format should I choose?

PNG is lossless and supports transparency. JPEG gives small photos but has no transparency. WebP is smaller than both and keeps transparency. AVIF is usually the smallest, in browsers that support it.

Are my images uploaded or stored?

No. Everything happens on your own device, so your photos stay private.

Is BG Studio really free?

Yes. There is no signup, no watermark and no daily limit. The site is supported by optional donations and sponsorships.

Does it use AI?

No. It detects the background color and removes matching pixels, which makes it very fast and completely private. It works best on plain or evenly lit backgrounds such as studio shots, logos, scans and signatures. It will not cut a person out of a busy scene.

Does it work on my phone?

Yes. The layout adapts to phones and tablets, and you can pick photos straight from your gallery or paste a screenshot.

Which image types can I use?

PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF (first frame), BMP and AVIF, up to 25 MB.

Paano alisin ang background ng picture? (Tagalog)

Ang BG Studio ay libreng background remover na gumagana mismo sa browser mo. Hindi ina-upload ang mga larawan mo, kaya pribado ito.

  1. I-drop, i-paste, o piliin ang larawan mula sa gallery o computer mo.
  2. I-click ang Remove background. Kung mali ang kulay na natanggal, i-click ang Pick color at pindutin ang background.
  3. Ayusin ang Tolerance hanggang malinis ang gilid, tapos i-download bilang PNG o WebP para manatiling transparent.

Puwede mo ring paliitin ang file size (compress), baguhin ang width at height, at i-convert ang PNG, JPG, WebP o AVIF. Pinakamaganda ito sa plain na background gaya ng ID photo, product photo, logo, at pirma.
